scope_notes: This paper SCAFFOLD uses persistent centered controls and one step size without an extra global step, distinct from 2501.04443 frozen-anchor/recomputed-batch simplified SCAFFOLD.

Finite deterministic conditional paths of the stated independent Rademacher law are checked, with full participation of two clients and equal server weights; sampling distributions and partial participation are outside scope.
One case starts with zero controls and H=2; the other has nonzero zero-sum controls and H=3. These exercise memory across rounds without asserting optimal control initialization.

Strongly convex scalar quadratics and three rounds only. 1e-12 absolute/relative tolerances are justified by exact rational arithmetic. The analysis paper linear-speedup, stationary-bias and asymptotic claims are not numerically certified.
